payload.content: Existence questions ('is there any', 'are there', 'does any X exist with...') collapse to a single boolean-shaped scalar: emit `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ... WHERE <cond>)` or `SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM ... WHERE <cond>`, not a list of matching rows. Do not enumerate rows when the question only asks whether at least one exists.

rationale: creative: tests existence → 0-or-1-row boolean granularity; prevents over-enumeration when the question is yes/no shaped.
